These intermediates are all known to interact with the GABA(A) Receptor Benzodiazepine Binding Site, indicating a possible pathway through which oxyphencyclimine may exert its effects. The consistent scores across the three paths, all with a final score of 0.7541, suggest a strong and reliable association, though the exact mechanism by which oxyphencyclimine influences the receptor remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but further research is needed to fully understand the interaction and its implications.
